patronOf.en-US: Bishop and Doctor of the Church

prayerExcerpt.en-US: In the integrity of that same faith your people may always find joy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Que o vosso povo sempre se alegre em conservá-la integralmente.

meta.face: A small, lean man of about seventy with a LONG, RECTANGULAR face — a broad, high forehead, a long, straight, prominent nose, deep-set dark eyes with heavy lids under arched grey brows, sunken cheeks under strong cheekbones and a narrow jaw; grey hair at the temples under the biretta, a trimmed grey moustache and a short, pointed grey goatee, and a mild, penetrating gaze toward the viewer.
meta.basis: The contemporary portrait at the Plantin-Moretus Museum (Wikipedia lead, consulted): a long face, prominent nose, heavy-lidded eyes, grey moustache and pointed goatee, in cardinal's red. Hobbes, who saw him in 1614, called him 'a little lean old man'.
